summary: the forward rows of etude_scenario_hosttest.c, under the stand-in and the real QEMU, find a forward, a restriction or a guest forward that the library or the launcher loses

argv: exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O1 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I tests/host -I tools/etude/include -I tools/etude -I tools/etude/posix -I tools/etude/guest -I utils tests/host/etude_scenario_hosttest.c ${SRC}/tools/etude/posix/scenario.c tools/etude/posix/case_main.c tools/etude/serial.c tools/etude/posix/qemu.c ${SRC}/tools/etude/qemu_profile.c tools/etude/posix/exec.c tools/etude/posix/keeper.c tools/etude/processor.c tools/etude/posix/process.c tools/etude/posix/store.c tools/etude/capture.c tools/etude/history_json.c tools/etude/guest/guest.c tools/etude/guest/fixture.c tools/etude/guest/wire.c utils/sha256.c -o ${WORK}/etude_scenario_hosttest

faults.name: forwards-dropped
faults.summary: the library gives the launcher none of the forwards of the profile's cards

faults.name: ports-dropped
faults.summary: the library gives the launcher none of the case's ports

faults.name: protocol-swapped
faults.summary: the launcher forwards the TCP port by UDP and the UDP port by TCP

faults.name: restrict-dropped
faults.summary: the library gives the launcher every card unrestricted

faults.name: guest-forwards-dropped
faults.summary: the library gives the launcher none of a card's guest forwards

faults.name: relay-unresolved
faults.summary: the library gives the launcher the relay's name in place of its path

faults.name: address-moved
faults.summary: the library gives the launcher another address than the manifest's
